issues.body:

device: 910C (1 * 8)
torch_npu: 2.8.0
vllm: 0.13.0
verl commit id: c4593e3cba71b3a5378007b7194fd350c0fd04cb
transformers: 4.57.6
scripts: examples/grpo_trainer/run_qwen3_vl-8b_npu.sh

### Information

- [x] The official example scripts
- [ ] My own modified scripts

### Tasks

- [x] An officially supported task in the `examples` folder (such as GLUE/SQuAD, ...)
- [ ] My own task or dataset (give details below)

### Reproduction

```bash

exp_name='GRPO-Qwen3_vl-8B-npu'
gen_tp=1
ENGINE=${1:-vllm}

TRAIN_FILE=/workspace/datasets/preprocessed/geo3k/train.parquet
TEST_FILE=/workspace/datasets/preprocessed/geo3k/test.parquet

# Rollout Correction parameters (sequence-level TIS + geometric RS)
rollout_is=sequence
rollout_is_threshold=2.0
rollout_is_batch_normalize=true
rollout_rs=token_k1
rollout_rs_threshold=0.6_1.6

python3 -m verl.trainer.main_ppo \

    data.train_files="${TRAIN_FILE}" \
    data.val_files="${TEST_FILE}" \
    data.train_batch_size=32 \

    data.max_response_length=2048 \
    data.filter_overlong_prompts=True \
    data.truncation='error' \

    actor_rollout_ref.model.use_remove_padding=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.model.use_fused_kernels=True \

    actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_type=low_var_kl \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.entropy_coeff=0 \
    actor_rollout_ref.model.enable_gradient_checkpointing=True \

    actor_rollout_ref.ref.entropy_from_logits_with_chunking=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.param_offload=False \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.optimizer_offload=False \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=20 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.tensor_model_parallel_size=${gen_tp} \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.name=$ENGINE \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization=0.8 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.enable_chunked_prefill=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.enforce_eager=False \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.free_cache_engine=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.forward_prefetch=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.ref.fsdp_config.forward_prefetch=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.n=5 \
    data.shuffle=False \
    actor_rollout_ref.ref.log_prob_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=20 \
    actor_rollout_ref.ref.fsdp_config.param_offload=True \
    algorithm.use_kl_in_reward=False \
    trainer.critic_warmup=0 \
    trainer.logger='["console"]' \
    trainer.project_name="${project_name}" \
    trainer.experiment_name="${exp_name}" \
    trainer.n_gpus_per_node=16 \
    trainer.nnodes=1 \
    trainer.default_local_dir=${CKPTS_DIR} \
    trainer.resume_mode=auto \
    algorithm.rollout_correction.rollout_is=${rollout_is} \
    algorithm.rollout_correction.rollout_is_threshold=${rollout_is_threshold} \
    algorithm.rollout_correction.rollout_is_batch_normalize=${rollout_is_batch_normalize} \
    algorithm.rollout_correction.rollout_rs=${rollout_rs} \
    algorithm.rollout_correction.rollout_rs_threshold=${rollout_rs_threshold} \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.calculate_log_probs=True \
    trainer.val_before_train=False \
    trainer.save_freq=-1 \
    trainer.test_freq=-1 \
    trainer.total_training_steps=200

This behavior is forbidden. You can fix this by cloning the output of the custom Function.
```

There are 2 methods to solve this issue:

Method1: modify /usr/local/python3.11.14/lib/python3.11/site-packages/transformers/models/qwen3_vl/modeling_qwen3_vl.py lines~875
from
```python
    def _deepstack_process(
        self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, visual_pos_masks: torch.Tensor, visual_embeds: torch.Tensor
    ):
        visual_pos_masks = visual_pos_masks.to(hidden_states.device)
        visual_embeds = visual_embeds.to(hidden_states.device, hidden_states.dtype)
        local_this = hidden_states[visual_pos_masks, :].clone() + visual_embeds
        hidden_states[visual_pos_masks, :] = local_this
        return hidden_states
```
to
```python
    def _deepstack_process(
        self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, visual_pos_masks: torch.Tensor, visual_embeds: torch.Tensor
    ):
        hidden_states = hidden_states.clone()
        visual_pos_masks = visual_pos_masks.to(hidden_states.device)
        visual_embeds = visual_embeds.to(hidden_states.device, hidden_states.dtype)
        hidden_states[visual_pos_masks, :] += visual_embeds
        return hidden_states
```
but this may increase memory consumption.

Method2: remove config: actor_rollout_ref.model.enable_activation_offload=True from script.

Is there any bug in enable_activation_offload logic?

### Expected behavior

Run examples/grpo_trainer/run_qwen3_vl-8b_npu.sh on npu normally with config: actor_rollout_ref.model.enable_activation_offload=True.

save_path=$2

TOTAL_EPOCHS=${TOTAL_EPOCHS:-1}
PROJECT_NAME=${PROJECT_NAME:-2b-sft}

    data.train_files="$TRAIN_FILES"
    data.val_files="$TEST_FILES"

    data.max_length=${MAX_PROMPT}
    data.truncation=error
    data.train_batch_size=${nproc_per_node}
    data.micro_batch_size_per_gpu=${MICRO_BATCH_SIZE_PER_GPU}
    data.max_token_len_per_gpu=32768
    data.ignore_input_ids_mismatch=True
    data.enable_thinking_default=False
)

MODEL=(
    model.use_liger=False
    model.use_fused_kernels=False
    model.use_remove_padding=False
    model.enable_gradient_checkpointing=False
    model.enable_activation_offload=False
)

ENGINE=(
    engine=fsdp
    engine.ulysses_sequence_parallel_size=${SP_SIZE}
)

torchrun --standalone --nnodes=1 --nproc_per_node=${nproc_per_node} \
    -m verl.trainer.sft_trainer \
    "${DATA[@]}" \
    "${MODEL[@]}" \
    "${ENGINE[@]}" \
    optim.lr=${LR} \
    model.path="${MODEL_PATH}" \
    trainer.default_local_dir="${save_path}" \
    trainer.project_name="${PROJECT_NAME}" \
    trainer.experiment_name="${EXPERIMENT_NAME}" \
    trainer.logger='["console"]' \
    trainer.total_epochs=${TOTAL_EPOCHS} \
    "$@"
